name: jarble-dev Phase 4 — GitHub, Budget, Incremental, Webhooks, Chaining, Tests
description: 6 features that make jarble-dev production-ready: GitHub PR creation, run budget guardrails, incremental runs, notification webhooks, plan chaining, and a full test suite.

tasks.name: types-and-config
tasks.description: Add all new types, interfaces, and config fields needed by all 6 Phase 4 features. This is the foundation task — every other task depends on it.

tasks.name: budget-guard
tasks.description: Create the BudgetGuard class that tracks cumulative cost across all agents in a run and can pause/stop when budget thresholds are hit.

tasks.name: notifier
tasks.description: Create the Notifier class that POSTs CI events to webhook URLs for Slack/Discord/custom integrations.

tasks.name: incremental-checker
tasks.description: Create the IncrementalChecker class that determines which tasks can be skipped based on git changes since the last successful run.

tasks.name: github-integration
tasks.description: Create the GitHubIntegration class that generates PR descriptions from run state and creates PRs via the gh CLI.

tasks.name: core-wiring
tasks.description: Wire BudgetGuard, Notifier, IncrementalChecker, and plan chaining into the orchestrator, agentSpawner, and planner. This is the integration task.

tasks.name: cli-wiring
tasks.description: Add new CLI commands (pr, multi-plan run) and flags (--budget, --webhook, --incremental) to cli.ts.

tasks.name: test-suite
tasks.description: Write a comprehensive Vitest test suite for the jarble-dev orchestrator covering all major modules.
tasks.prompt:
You are writing a comprehensive Vitest test suite for the jarble-dev orchestrator package.

First, read ALL source files in jarble-dev/src/ to understand the full codebase. Key files:
- types.ts, config.ts, planner.ts, planValidator.ts, stateStore.ts
- reportGenerator.ts, budgetGuard.ts, incrementalChecker.ts, notifier.ts
- templates.ts, orchestrator.ts, agentSpawner.ts, merger.ts

## Setup

### 1. Add vitest to package.json:
Edit jarble-dev/package.json to add:
- devDependencies: `"vitest": "^3.0.0"`
- scripts: `"test": "vitest run"`

### 2. Create jarble-dev/vitest.config.ts:
```typescript
import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config';

export default defineConfig({
  test: {
    globals: true,
    include: ['src/__tests__/**/*.test.ts'],
  },
});
```

### 3. Create test files:

#### jarble-dev/src/__tests__/planner.test.ts:
Test the Planner class:
- `hydratePlan()`: assigns IDs, resolves dependency names to IDs
- `topoSort()`: returns correct order, detects cycles (should throw)
- `getReadyTasks()`: returns only pending tasks with all deps done
- `detectFileConflicts()`: finds overlapping touchesFiles
- `serialize()`: strips runtime fields

Use a mock Logger (just needs the method signatures, can be empty stubs).

#### jarble-dev/src/__tests__/planValidator.test.ts:
Test PlanValidator:
- Missing fields (name, tasks, task.name, task.prompt, task.description)
- Invalid dependency references
- Cycle detection
- Invalid agent type (mock discoverAgents to return known set)
- Invalid permission mode
- File conflict warnings
- High budget warnings
- Valid plan passes

#### jarble-dev/src/__tests__/stateStore.test.ts:
Test StateStore:
- save() then load() round-trips correctly (Dates survive, Maps survive)
- load() returns null for missing file
- findLatest() returns most recent state file
- Use os.tmpdir() for test files, clean up in afterEach

#### jarble-dev/src/__tests__/reportGenerator.test.ts:
Test ReportGenerator:
- fromState() produces string output with key sections
- toJSON() produces valid JSON with correct structure
- aggregateHistory() handles empty directory
- aggregateHistory() handles multiple state files

Create mock OrchestratorState objects for testing.

#### jarble-dev/src/__tests__/budgetGuard.test.ts:
Test BudgetGuard:
- canSpawn() returns true when under budget
- canSpawn() returns false after budget exceeded
- recordCost() emits 'budget:warning' at threshold
- recordCost() emits 'budget:exceeded' at limit
- remaining() returns correct value
- getStatus() returns correct BudgetStatus
- Unlimited budget (limit=0) never pauses
- perAgentBudget() caps to remaining budget
- reset() clears state

#### jarble-dev/src/__tests__/incrementalChecker.test.ts:
Test IncrementalChecker:
- markUnchangedTasks() runs all tasks when no previous success
- markUnchangedTasks() skips tasks with unchanged files
- markUnchangedTasks() runs tasks with changed files
- markUnchangedTasks() runs tasks with empty touchesFiles
- Prefix matching works (directory entry matches files within)
- saveSuccessCommit() + getLastSuccessfulCommit() round-trip

Note: Some tests will need to mock execSync. Use vi.mock('child_process').

#### jarble-dev/src/__tests__/notifier.test.ts:
Test Notifier:
- subscribe() attaches to EventEmitter
- notify() calls fetch for each webhook URL
- Handles fetch errors gracefully (doesn't throw)
- flush() resolves after all pending notifications
- Events are sent in order

Mock global fetch: `vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn())`

#### jarble-dev/src/__tests__/templates.test.ts:
Test plan templates:
- All templates have required fields (name, description, plan)
- All template plans have valid structure (tasks array, each task has name, prompt, description)
- All template task dependencies reference tasks that exist in the same plan
- Template plan validates through PlanValidator (mock the agent discovery)

IMPORTANT:
- Install vitest first: run `cd jarble-dev && npm install --save-dev vitest`
- Create the __tests__ directory: `mkdir -p jarble-dev/src/__tests__`
- Use `vi.mock()` for mocking modules, `vi.fn()` for mock functions
- Create a shared mock logger helper that all tests can import
- Each test file should be self-contained with its own imports
- Run `npm test` at the end to verify all tests pass
- Fix any failing tests before committing
- Commit with message: 'test(jarble-dev): add comprehensive test suite for all modules'
